description_zh: 获取当前阿里云账号下指定内网访问策略的详情信息
name: GetPrivateAccessPolicy

parameters.help_en:
Intranet access policy ID. The value can be obtained from:
[ListPrivateAccessPolices](~~ListPrivateAccessPolices~~): Query multiple intranet access policies in bulk.
[CreatePrivateAccessPolicy](~~CreatePrivateAccessPolicy~~): Create an intranet access policy
parameters.help_zh:
内网访问策略ID。取值来源：
[ListPrivateAccessPolices](~~ListPrivateAccessPolices~~)：批量查询内网访问策略。
[CreatePrivateAccessPolicy](~~CreatePrivateAccessPolicy~~)：创建内网访问策略
parameters.name: policy_id

ApplicationIds.description_en: A collection of application IDs for the private access policy. This field has a value when the application type is Application
ApplicationIds.description_zh: 内网访问策略的应用ID集合。当应用类型为Application时，该字段有值

items.description_en: The application ID for the private access policy

ApplicationType.description_en:
The application type of the private access policy. Possible values:
Application: Application.
Tag: Tag
ApplicationType.description_zh:
内网访问策略的应用类型。取值：
Application：应用。
Tag：标签

CreateTime.description_zh: 内网访问策略创建时间

CustomUserAttributes.description_en: Collection of custom user group attributes. Multiple custom user group attributes are combined with an OR relationship and take effect as a set
CustomUserAttributes.description_zh: 自定义用户组属性集合。多个自定义用户组属性之间是或的关系，按照合集生效

IdpId.description_en: The identity provider ID for the custom user group. This field is required when the custom user group type is department
IdpId.description_zh: 自定义用户组的身份源ID。当自定义用户组类型为department时，必填

Relation.description_en: Custom user group relationship. Values: - Equal: Equal to. - Unequal: Not equal to
Relation.description_zh:
自定义用户组的关系。取值：
Equal：等于。
Unequal：不等于

UserGroupType.description_en:
Type of the custom user group. Values:
username: Username.
department: Department.
email: Email.
telephone: Telephone
UserGroupType.description_zh:
自定义用户组的类型。取值：
username：用户名。
department：部门。
email：邮箱。
telephone：手机

Value.description_en:
The value of the custom user group attribute.
When the user group type is username, it represents the value of the username. The length should be 1 to 128 characters, supporting Chinese and case-sensitive English letters, and can include numbers, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-).
When the user group type is department, it represents the value of the department. For example: OU=Department1,OU=SASE DingTalk.
When the user group type is email, it represents the value of the email. For example: username@example.com.
When the user group type is telephone, it represents the value of the phone number. For example: 13900001234
Value.description_zh:
自定义用户组属性的值。
当用户组类型为username时，表示用户名的值。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。
当用户组类型为department时，表示部门的值。如：OU=部门1,OU=SASE钉钉。
当用户组类型为email时，表示邮箱的值。如：username@example.com。
当用户组类型为telephone时，表示手机的值。如：13900001234

Description.example: 这是一条内网访问策略

DeviceAttributeAction.description_en:
The action to take if the security baseline is not met. Possible values:

Block: Block.
Observe: Observe
DeviceAttributeAction.description_zh:
不满足安全基线的执行策略。取值：

Block：拦截。
Observe：观察

DeviceAttributeId.description_en: The ID of the security baseline policy

PolicyAction.description_en:
Intranet access policy action. Values:
Block: Block.
Allow: Allow
PolicyAction.description_zh:
内网访问策略动作。取值：
Block：阻断。
Allow：允许

Priority.description_en: Intranet access policy priority. A value of 1 indicates the highest priority
Priority.description_zh: 内网访问策略优先级。数字1表示优先级最高

Status.description_en:
Intranet access policy status. Values:
Enabled: Enabled.
Disabled: Disabled
Status.description_zh:
内网访问策略状态。取值：
Enabled：开启。
Disabled：关闭

TagIds.description_en: A collection of tag IDs for the private access policy. This field has a value when the application type is Tag
TagIds.description_zh: 内网访问策略的标签ID集合。当应用类型为Tag时，该字段有值

items.description_en: The tag ID for the private access policy

TrustedProcessGroupIds.description_en: A list of trusted process group IDs

TrustedProcessStatus.description_en:
The status of the trusted process switch. Possible values:
Enabled: Enabled.
Disabled: Disabled
TrustedProcessStatus.description_zh:
可信进程开关状态。取值：
Enabled：开启。
Disabled：关闭

TrustedSoftwareIds.description_en: A list of trusted software IDs

UserGroupIds.description_en: Collection of user group IDs for the intranet access policy. This field is populated when the user group type is Normal
UserGroupIds.description_zh: 内网访问策略，用户组ID集合。当用户组类型为Normal时，该字段有值

items.description_en: User group ID for the intranet access policy, where the user group type is Normal
items.description_zh: 内网访问策略，用户组类型为Normal的用户组ID

UserGroupMode.description_en:
User group type for the intranet access policy. Values:
Normal: Normal user group.
Custom: Custom user group
UserGroupMode.description_zh:
内网访问策略的用户组类型。取值：
Normal：普通用户组。
Custom：自定义用户组

ValidFrom.description_en: The start time when the zero trust policy takes effect, represented as a timestamp in seconds
ValidFrom.description_zh: 零信任策略的生效起始时间，为秒级时间戳

ValidTimeStatus.description_en: Switch status for effective time. Values: - Enabled: On. - Disabled: Off
ValidTimeStatus.description_zh:
生效时间开关状态。取值：
Enabled：开启。
Disabled：关闭

ValidUntil.description_en: The expiration time of the zero trust policy, in seconds timestamp
ValidUntil.description_zh: 零信任策略的生效截止时间，为秒级时间戳

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the current request
